rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for giving or conferring something.

example.english: I’ll bestow an opportunity on you to have a try.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 go3 gei1 wui6 nei5 si3 haa5

rows.note: Choose this when bestowing something specifically as a gift.

example.english: This gift is something I bestow on you.
example.traditional: 呢份禮物係我送畀你嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 ngo5 sung3 bei2 nei5 ge3

rows.note: Use this for formally presenting an award, prize, certificate, or other honour.

example.english: The organizers will bestow the awards next week.
example.traditional: 大會將於下星期頒發獎項。
example.jyutping: daai6 wui6 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 sing1 kei4 baan1 faat3 zoeng2 hong6

rows.note: Choose this when conferring a title, status, right, or official honour.

example.english: The university will formally bestow honorary fellow status on them.
example.traditional: 校方將正式授予佢榮譽院士資格。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 zoeng1 zing3 sik1 sau6 jyu5 keoi5 wing4 jyu6 jyun6 si6 zi1 gaak3
